request.description: Rejects a pending change with a required note; the version goes back to `draft` for the maker to fix and resubmit. Publishes `config.change_decided`. Staff only. The checker inbox for every versioned config resource (question sets now; routing rules, consent templates, lender products and more later). Lists only resources the caller may read. Deciding needs approve access (ops lead, compliance, super admin) and the checker must not be the maker.
